skill.name: claude-speed-reader
skill.description: Speed read Claude responses with RSVP-style text flow and Spritz-style ORP highlighting guidance.
skill.summary: Guides users in preparing Claude responses for faster RSVP-based reading.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: This is a prompt-only skill with no executable code. The two static network findings are GitHub repository links in metadata and documentation, not runtime network access.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is a source repository value in the skill front matter. It does not cause network access or transmit user data.
The URL is a documentation link to the source repository. No executable code or instruction sends data to that URL.

content.value_statement: Long AI answers can be slow to scan during focused work. This skill helps prepare Claude responses for faster RSVP-style reading with ORP highlighting guidance.
actual_capabilities: Describes a workflow for speed reading Claude responses at high words per minute.
References RSVP text presentation as the main reading method.
References Spritz-style optimal recognition point highlighting.
Provides basic guidance on when to use the reading workflow.
Links to the source repository for additional project context.
limitations: Does not include executable code or a built-in reader interface.
Does not verify or guarantee a specific reading speed.
Does not process files, websites, or private data by itself.
Depends on the host assistant to format usable reading text.

use_cases.title: Review Long Answers Faster
use_cases.description: Convert a detailed Claude response into text that is easier to scan with an RSVP reader.

use_cases.title: Read Technical Explanations
use_cases.description: Prepare dense explanations for focused sequential reading while preserving key terms.

use_cases.title: Summarize Meeting Notes
use_cases.description: Turn long notes into a concise reading stream for quick review before follow-up work.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Short Response
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner use with a brief answer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare your previous answer for speed reading. Keep the meaning intact, remove filler, and use short sentence groups.

prompt_templates.title: Condense a Long Explanation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate use with a detailed answer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite the explanation below for RSVP-style reading. Preserve important terms, simplify long sentences, and remove repeated points.

prompt_templates.title: Create Focused Reading Segments
prompt_templates.prompt: Transform this material into ordered speed-reading segments. Separate definitions, decisions, risks, and next actions into clear reading passes.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize for ORP Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced use with strict reading constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare this response for Spritz-style ORP review. Use concise wording, stable terminology, and a final pass with only essential facts.

output_examples.input: A long Claude answer about project planning, risks, and next steps.
output_examples.output: A concise sequence of short reading segments covering goals, risks, decisions, and next actions.

output_examples.input: A dense technical explanation with repeated terms and long paragraphs.
output_examples.output: A cleaned reading version with shorter sentences, preserved technical terms, and reduced repetition.

output_examples.input: Meeting notes that need a quick review before a status update.
output_examples.output: A compact reading stream that highlights decisions, blockers, owners, and follow-up tasks.

best_practices: Use it on finished responses after accuracy review.
Ask for key terms to remain unchanged.
Review the condensed text before acting on it.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as a substitute for understanding critical details.
Do not remove citations or source context from research material.
Do not assume the skill provides a working reading application.

faq.question: Does this skill install a speed reader?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides prompt guidance and documentation context, not executable reader software.

faq.question: What does RSVP mean here?
faq.answer: RSVP means rapid serial visual presentation, where text is read one segment at a time.

faq.question: What is ORP highlighting?
faq.answer: ORP means optimal recognition point. It marks a helpful point in a word for faster recognition.

faq.question: Can it guarantee 600 WPM reading?
faq.answer: No. Reading speed depends on the person, the material, and the display tool used.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide response formatting in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it send data to the linked repository?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The repository URL is presented as a source link, not as a data transfer path.
